enable_cri.description: Enable the CRI plugin to support Kubernetes container runtime API.

state_dir.description: Directory for containerd runtime state (sockets, PID files, etc.).

snapshotter.description: Default snapshotter used for container filesystem layers (e.g., 'overlayfs', 'btrfs', 'devmapper').

default_runtime_name.description: Default container runtime to use for containers (e.g., 'runc', 'kata-runtime').

no_pivot.description: Disable pivot root (not recommended for production — useful only in constrained environments).

overlayfs_native_diff.description: Use native diff algorithm for overlayfs snapshots (slower but accurate; fallback if 'diff' fails).

registry_mirrors.description: Registry mirrors to use for image pulls — each mirror redirects requests for a registry host.

registry_configs.description: Authentication configs for private registries (username/password or token).

registry_tls_configs.description: TLS certificates and settings for private registries.

key_file.description: Path to client private key file (optional).

sandbox_image.description: Image used for Kubernetes sandbox (pause) containers.

image_pull_timeout.description: Timeout for image pull operations in seconds (0 = unlimited).

cni_conf_dir.description: Path to CNI network configuration directory.

cni_default_network.description: Optional fallback CNI network config (when no config file exists).

conf_file.description: Path to fallback CNI config file (e.g., /etc/cni/net.d/10-default.conf).

ip_range.description: IP subnet for fallback network (CIDR, e.g., '10.1.0.0/16').

max_container_log_size.description: Maximum size (in bytes) of container stdout/stderr logs.

image_deletion.description: Enable automatic deletion of unused images (recommended in production).

grpc_address.description: Unix socket path for containerd gRPC API.

grpc_max_recv_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC receive message size in bytes.

grpc_max_send_message_size.description: Maximum gRPC send message size in bytes.

debug_level.description: Log level for containerd (debug, info, warn, error, etc.).

pprof_enabled.description: Enable pprof CPU/memory profiling endpoint (disabled by default).

metrics_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between metric exports (set to 0 to disable).

root_dir.description: Root directory for persistent containerd data (snapshots, image layers).

privileged_without_host_devices.description: Grant privileges to containers without exposing host devices (Kubernetes-specific).

devmapper_pool_name.description: Device mapper pool name (if using devmapper snapshotter).
